intro: If Goa has been on your list, consider this your sign. Beaches, Portuguese lanes and long lazy sunsets, all within reach of a short holiday.

sections.heading: Why visit Goa
paragraphs: Goa (West India) is known for its beach, nightlife and food experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to February, when the weather is dry and pleasant.

list: Sunset at Vagator or Chapora Fort

sections.heading: How to get there

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Goa?

Fly into Goa (Dabolim or Mopa) or take an overnight train to Madgaon or Thivim.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Goa?
faq.a: Popular choices: Anjuna / Vagator for cafés and nightlife; Palolem / Agonda for calm beaches; Panaji for heritage and easy transfers.
